questions: Section 5 says both lipid tables are in force, then refers to underwriting judgement where two tables point at different bands. On this file total cholesterol 328 falls in the 75 band and the 6.3 ratio falls in the 25 band. Do I add both to 100, or charge only the worse single band of 75?

Section 16 refers combinations of cardiac risk factors to underwriting judgement. Where an elevated lipid panel is the only cardiac risk factor on the file - blood pressure, A1c, tobacco and family history all clean - is the lipid debit charged in full, or is it credited down?

No lipid table names a modifier. For an isolated lipid elevation of this size, is a flat extra or an exclusion rider ever used in place of the table debits, or are lipids always carried as debits alone?
